summary.text: Mike Howard, listed by Ballotpedia as Michael Howard, is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 51A and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Frank Pafko. He is a former Richfield City Council member and communications professional.

paragraphs.text: Mike Howard was born in Becker, Minnesota, and lives in Richfield.
He earned a B.A. in political science from Augsburg College in 2005.

Ballotpedia says his career includes work as a communications specialist and communications director at the Minnesota House of Representatives, public affairs manager for the Minnesota Department of Education, and director of communications for the Minnesota Super Bowl Host committee.
Howard was elected to the Richfield City Council in 2014.
He won the House seat for District 50A on November 6, 2018, defeating Kirsten Johnson, and defeated Jeffrey Thompson in District 51A on November 5, 2024.
For 2025-2026 he is co-chair of the House Housing Finance and Policy Committee and serves on the Rules and Legislative Administration and State Government Finance and Policy committees.
